purpose: Attack the exact missing lemma of v0.3: can arbitrary 3-CNF satisfiability support be represented by one selected row from each variable pair so that Cauchy-Binet collapses all assignments into one determinant?

counterexample_formula.formula: (x1 OR NOT x2 OR x3) AND (x1 OR x2 OR x4) AND (NOT x2 OR x3 OR x4)

forbidden_representation.model: For each variable i choose two row vectors r_i^0,r_i^1 over an arbitrary field K. For assignment a, form the 4x4 matrix R(a) whose i-th row is r_i^{a_i}. Require det R(a) != 0 iff F(a)=1.
forbidden_representation.claim: No such representation exists over any field.
forbidden_representation.relation_to_v0_3: This is exactly the zero/nonzero support obligation needed by the one-row-pair Cauchy-Binet Boolean selector. It is stronger than falsifying exact 0/1 minor values.

proof.reference_assignment: b=1000 is satisfying, so R(b) is invertible. Use its four selected rows as a basis.
principal_minor_reduction: Express the opposite row choice for variable i in coordinates of the basis R(b), and put these four coordinate rows into a 4x4 matrix M=(m_ij).

For any assignment obtained from b by flipping the variable set S, det R(a)/det R(b) = det M[S,S]. This follows by factoring R(a)=P_S R(b), where P_S is the identity with exactly the rows in S replaced by the corresponding rows of M.
Therefore the selected SAT/UNSAT statuses impose zero/nonzero conditions on principal minors p_S=det M[S,S].
translated_conditions: 0000 is UNSAT and differs from b in {1}: p_1=0, hence m_11=0.
1100 is UNSAT and differs from b in {2}: p_2=0, hence m_22=0.
0100 is UNSAT and differs from b in {1,2}: p_12=0. With m_11=m_22=0 this gives m_12*m_21=0.
0001 is SAT and differs from b in {1,4}: p_14 != 0. Hence m_14*m_41 != 0.
1101 is SAT and differs from b in {2,4}: p_24 != 0. Hence m_24*m_42 != 0.
0101 is UNSAT and differs from b in {1,2,4}: p_124=0.
0110 is SAT and differs from b in {1,2,3}: p_123 != 0.
contradiction: Because m_12*m_21=0, the first term is zero.
Because m_14,m_41,m_24,m_42 are all nonzero, p_124=0 forces BOTH m_12=0 and m_21=0: if m_12=0 then m_14*m_21*m_42=0 implies m_21=0; symmetrically if m_21=0 then m_12*m_24*m_41=0 implies m_12=0.
But the satisfying assignment 0110 requires p_123 != 0. Contradiction.
proof.field_scope: The argument uses only determinant identities and absence of zero divisors, so it holds over every field, including characteristic 2.

consequence.killed: UNIVERSAL_NONNEGATIVE_TRANSVERSAL_MINOR_REPRESENTATION_FOR_3CNF in the one-row-pair-per-variable model of v0.3.
consequence.preserved_positive_result: The Cauchy-Binet selector identity itself remains exact; what fails is universal localization of arbitrary 3-CNF satisfaction into its selected minors.
not_killed: determinant constructions where a variable controls multiple coupled rows/columns
nonlinear/global cancellation not expressible as one transversal minor per assignment

source_alignment.source: Lin and Sturmfels, Polynomial relations among principal minors of a 4x4-matrix, Journal of Algebra 322 (2009)
source_alignment.relevance: Principal-minor vectors satisfy nontrivial algebraic relations already for 4x4 matrices; the proof here uses an even smaller zero-pattern consequence tailored to the frozen SAT counterexample.

source_alignment.source: Aravind et al., Learning Read-Once Determinants and the Principal Minor Assignment Problem, STOC 2026 / arXiv:2603.04255
source_alignment.relevance: Rank-one symbolic determinants are equivalent to read-once determinants and connect directly to principal-minor assignment, matching the normalization used in this obstruction.

next_gate.name: E8_COUPLED_BLOCK_OR_COLORED_DETERMINANT_CANCELLATION_V0_5
next_gate.directive: Do not repair v0.3 by fixed mandatory padding or another single row pair. The next candidate must allow genuinely coupled multi-occurrence/global structure while retaining polynomial construction and polynomial determinant-like evaluation.
next_gate.preferred_attack: Test whether a coupled colored-determinant/conditional-stack representation can encode SAT support while admitting a polynomial-time zero/nonzero decision that avoids evaluating the VNP-complete polynomial itself.
next_gate.firewall: If zero/nonzero of the candidate invariant is itself NP-hard/#P-hard or requires exponential state, reject it rather than rename it a solver.

scientific_ceiling.PROVEN_IF_REPLAY_PASSES: The one-row-pair Cauchy-Binet SAT-support route is impossible even for an explicit 3-clause 4-variable 3-CNF, over every field.
